objects.name: PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress
objects.description: Over 22.6 million exposed instances are potentially affected by the critical PHP flaws that have been targeted for over a week. The post PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress appeared first on SecurityWeek .
